Polaroid Polacolor 679: real multicolor diamond logo, blue field and printed color-grid sample retained; no invented rainbow band. Pack Film / 10exp per pack / ISO 100 / Instant matches catalog (reference box is two 10-photo packs).
Minolta 16 Color Film For Prints: pale cream/green palette, authentic Minolta 16 identity and instant-loading circle motif match the packaging. 16mm / 20exp / ISO 100 / C-41 verified.

Hope Film Bubble: cyan bubbles, three white ducks and the question mark match the real packaging; 35mm / 24exp / ISO 200 / C-41 verified. Clean compact brand and stock hero.
Boots Colour Print Film: dark navy, compact authentic Boots oval and rainbow stripe match the scan; stock title follows catalog. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / C-41 verified.
Reto Amber D400: red/amber/cyan gradient and white daylight sunburst are present on the real package. Accurate stock name and 35mm / 27exp / ISO 400 / C-41 footer; accepted.
Rollei Retro 80S: gray field, green stock lettering and authentic black wordmark match the exact 35mm edition. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 80 / BW verified; restrained hierarchy accepted.
Ilford XP2 Super: authentic red horizontal stripe lettering and black italic Super match the package; compact ILFORD header and 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / C-41 footer verified.
Konica Color II: film-can label provides the authentic orange/cream palette, black-yellow band and Konica mark. Stock name, 35mm / 110ft / ISO 100 / C-41 match the catalog and reference.

Polaroid PolaChrome 35mm refinement: removed the non-reference rainbow. Blue-white palette, italic title and cream-framed architectural sample now match the exact English front panel. 35mm / 12exp / ISO 40 / Instant verified.
Agfa Fine-Grain Plenachrome: orange/navy tin-label palette, authentic Agfa script and exact stock lettering preserved. 35mm / 27.5ft / BW matches the package; no ISO invented.
ADOX HR 50: compact authentic outlined ADOX mark, black/red body and orange-red vertical stripe pattern match the exact packaging; HR 50 is legible. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 50 / BW verified.
Foma Fomapan 200 bulk-roll label: authentic white/gray/red stripes and blue Foma script preserved. 35mm / 100ft / ISO 200 / BW agrees with the 30.5m package and catalog.
Kirkland Signature Color Print Film: purple bands, cream ground, multicolor brush stroke and authentic black Signature lockup match this exact package. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 200 / C-41 verified.
Mutascan: authentic filmstrip-heart emblem restored beside compact brand, exact yellow-black palette and Kodak Vision3 500T/5219 title preserved; 35mm / 100ft / ISO 500 / ECN-2 verified.

Kentmere PAN 200 refinement: K moved into the compact header and PAN 200 centered consistently with approved PAN 100/400 covers. Distinctive blue/gray/olive/yellow diagonal blocks and 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / BW preserved.
Foma Ortho 400 35mm edition: authentic cream/olive/cyan blocks and printed perforation motif preserved, compact red script and clear stock title. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / BW verified.

Marix 320T refinement: restored authentic 320T stock as the main readable title, colorful angular MARIX wordmark, cream and purple palette and real perforation band preserved. Generic description is secondary. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 320 / C-41 verified against the exact box.
Agfa Agfapan APX 400: true gray/red bands, printed tonal circles and outlined APX lettering retained. Brand and stock match the package; 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / BW verified.
Agfa Agfapan APX 100: same authentic gray/red family with tonal-circle motif and correctly distinguished APX 100 stock. Exact 35mm / 24exp / ISO 100 / BW footer verified.
Reflx Lab 250D: true pale blue ground, red semicircle and light cloud/stripe shapes retained from this 120 package. Wide 250D title and 120 / ISO 250 / ECN-2 footer verified.
Reflx Lab Pro 100: muted green/cream split and authentic dashed dividing line retained, no extra motifs. Pro 100 title and exact 220 / ISO 100 / C-41 footer verified against this edition.
CatLABS X Film 320 Pro: authentic cream and black palette, serif CatLABS wordmark, thin X FILM 320 lettering and black PRO band match the exact 120 package. 120 / ISO 320 / BW verified.

Agfa Agfapan APX 25: silver gray fine rules, red accent stripe, authentic gray circle field and outlined APX 25 lettering match the original package and the approved APX family. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 25 / BW checked.

Hasselblad Hassel-plåtar E.R.Orto: authentic golden yellow and dark brown ink, ornate border, winged emblem and flowing historical script preserved. Compact brand and small 6.5x9cm / 12 Sheets / BW footer keep the app hierarchy clear.

Foton Fotopan F: exact green, yellow and black packaging, oval FOTON logo, tall yellow FOTOPAN and cream F in a black block retained. 120 / ISO 50 / BW verified. Main stock stays readable with a small technical footer.

Hands On Film Midnight 1600: authentic navy and warm cream printed label, striped awning and cartoon film-roll mascot match the box. Midnight 1600 is clear, brand compact and 35mm / 36exp / ISO 1600 / C-41 footer verified.

Illingworth's Fleet H&D: cream and black historical label, distinctive condensed serif wordmark, bold FLEET and simple horizontal rules retained. H&D remains secondary; 6.5x9cm / 12 Sheets / BW footer checked, no invented modern ISO.

Defender Portrait HGS: olive paper, green diamond DEFENDER mark and authentic green diagonal bars through PORTRAIT HGS match the original label. 12x16.5cm / 12 Sheets / BW footer retained, format remains small.
Building 2 200T: orange-red field, compact white BUILDING 2 emblem and subtle real concentric-line motif match the original box. 200T remains the hero; 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / ECN-2 verified.

Building 2 250D: exact deep blue, compact white emblem and authentic faint concentric rings retained. Hierarchy matches 200T while the original blue differentiates this stock. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 250 / ECN-2 checked.

Building 2 500T: original vivid red, compact white brand emblem and real tonal circular rules preserved. Clear 500T title and small 35mm / 36exp / ISO 500 / ECN-2 footer match the package and approved Building 2 family.

Building 2 50D: brighter royal blue of this edition, white emblem, large 50D and faint circular motif match the exact box. Same compact hierarchy as the other three Building 2 stocks. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 50 / ECN-2 verified.

Ferrania Solaris: authentic navy, magenta curved band and rainbow shaded solar disc match this FG Plus ISO 200 box. Italic white outlined Solaris remains prominent, Ferrania compact. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Film Never Die IRO: original red and cream with navy seigaiha waves, cherry blossoms and Mount Fuji are present on this exact box and correctly retained. Compact stacked brand, prominent IRO and 35mm / 27exp / ISO 400 / C-41 footer checked.

Film Never Die Kiro: black, yellow and cream with authentic sleeping leopard, foliage, clouds and sun match the original pack. Brand compact, KiRO clear; 35mm / 27exp / ISO 400 / C-41 checked. Illustration retained without invented decoration.

Lomography LomoChrome Color 92: exact package uses a seaside figure in red, black stock panel and cream/gold condensed type; these are correctly retained. Compact red Lomography wordmark. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / C-41 verified.

Lomography LomoChrome Purple: authentic purple box identity, pink-purple foliage and bridge sample theme preserved with compact wordmark and clear title. Footer corrected to the actual ISO 100–400 range printed on the package; 35mm / 36exp / C-41 verified.

Space Cat Film Mars 250D: original red-to-deep-purple palette, cream slanted stacked MARS 250D lettering and compact stacked brand retained. Dark lower texture stays subordinate. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 250 / C-41 checked against the remjet-free package.

Walkens Speed 400: exact cream paper, orange wide italic SPEED 400 type and restrained compact brand retained. Authentic simple label identity without invented graphics. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / C-41 checked.

Lomography LomoChrome Metropolis: original acid yellow, compact red brand and muted urban sample with red hat match the exact package. Stock title remains clear; footer now faithfully shows 35mm / 36exp / ISO 100–400 / C-41.

CineStill 50D: authentic blue, black and cream circular graphic identity and thin italic 50D lettering retained in a clean square composition. Compact CineStill wordmark; 35mm / 36exp / ISO 50 / C-41 verified.

CineStill 400Dynamic 120: exact violet, cream thin italic 400Dynamic lettering and compact CineStill FILM lockup preserved. Restrained spacing matches the app while retaining this edition's identity. 120 / ISO 400 / C-41 checked.

CineStill BWXX 120: gray and cream palette, authentic BW/XX monogram and small CineStill FILM brand match this Double-X package. Footer retains 120 / D96 from the catalog without inventing an ISO value. Clean flat print, no added symbols.

AgfaPhoto Vista Plus 200: exact red, white AGFAPHOTO strip, multicolor italic vista, yellow plus 200 block and printed curl/person-and-flowers sample match the original package. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Rollei RPX 100: authentic black, light gray Rollei wordmark and lime-green RPX 100 typography retained. Clear hierarchy without added motifs. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 100 / BW verified against this edition.
Rollei RPX 400: original black, light gray Rollei logo and red RPX 400 retained. Spacing and visual weight match RPX 100 while preserving the correct stock color. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / BW checked.

Reflx Lab Pro 100 127: real teal-green, cream panel, slanted dashed divider and italic Pro 100 retained, consistent with the approved 220 edition while preserving this brighter package color. 127 / ISO 100 / C-41 verified.

Premium Super XG refinement: compacted PREMIUM header and technical footer now fit the shared hierarchy. Exact red, deep blue and muted gold, authentic striped XG and angled panel preserved. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 100 / C-41 checked.

Lloyds Pharmacy Colour Film 200: exact teal header, blue field, lime 200 and original multicolor circular pharmacy emblem preserved. Long brand lockup stays in one compact header. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Konica Centuria 200: original cobalt blue, shaded orange-to-black disc, yellow italic CENTURIA and white 200 retained. Brand remains compact; real printed text shadow preserved. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Max Spielmann Maxi Color: authentic navy, red-orange-yellow diagonal stripes and bold black outlined MAXI COLOR retained. Small serif brand header, clear product lettering and 35mm / 24exp / ISO 400 / C-41 footer verified.

Konica KonicaColor VX 100: authentic cobalt blue, white VX above yellow 100 in black square and genuine multicolor fan retained. Compact Konica header, stock hierarchy clear. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 100 / C-41 verified.

Klick 400ASA: original yellow-to-red field, white Klick in red block and blue ASA block preserved. Stock 400ASA is the hero while exposure count stays in the footer. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 400 / C-41 checked.

Agfa Agfacolor CT18: authentic dark blue, orange-red label, yellow and cream border, script Agfacolor and diamond Agfa retained. CT18 clear; 35mm / 20exp / ISO 50 checked from real 18 DIN / 50 ASA package. No invented process.

Phöbus-Platten Sheet Film: original moss green and cream, flowing historical script wordmark and simple label character retained. Generic Sheet Film title remains appropriate because the exact pack has no clearer stock designation. 12x16.5cm / 12 Sheets / BW verified.

Agfa Trockenplatten historical edition refinement: redundant standalone top brand removed; authentic central engraved Agfa/Trockenplatten emblem retained. Exact orange, dark rules, cream and blue print character preserved. 9x12cm / 12 Sheets / BW footer checked.

Defender Extra Fast Panchromatic: authentic pale olive patterned paper, dark green oval/diamond product lockup and red diagonal bars preserved. Distinct from Portrait HGS while maintaining the family palette. 12x16.5cm / 12 Sheets / BW checked.

Defender Extra Special Fast Panchromatic refinement: authentic red wavy bars restored behind the green stock lettering, distinct from straight red bars of Extra Fast. Olive patterned paper and compact DEFENDER Film retained. 12x16.5cm / 12 Sheets / BW checked.

Agfa Trockenplatten: historical cream label, dark blue ornamental lettering, botanical print character and orange side stripe with dark rules retained from the real package. Clear stock name and small 9x12cm / 12 Sheets / BW footer; clean paper replaces physical wear.

Agfa Extra Rapid Platten: original burgundy box, cream script, dark oval product label and orange side stripe with dark rules faithfully adapted. Compact Agfa header and 9x12cm / 12 Sheets / BW footer checked. No physical wear reproduced.

Gevaert Ultra Panchro Normal: authentic olive paper, purple Gevaert script and green stock-label color restored. Footer faithfully retains original historical 30-degree marking without assuming a modern ISO conversion. 12x16.5cm / 12 Sheets / BW verified.

Konica Minolta Commercial Color Film refinement: exact Japanese title, blue-white palette and compact Konica Minolta striped-globe lockup retained. Oversized 135-24 removed so technical format no longer competes. ISO 100 clear; 35mm / 24exp / ISO 100 / C-41 footer checked.

Konica Infrared 750nm: authentic cobalt blue, black strip, red italic INFRARED 750nm and genuine grayscale fan graphic match the exact 120 box. Compact white Konica brand. Footer 120 / ISO 32 / BW retained from catalog.

Agfa Optima II 400: original silver-gray, red rules, pixelated warm color strip and green 400 block retained. Correct II designation, cream shadowed OPTIMA and small PROFESSIONAL line match exact package. 120 / ISO 400 / C-41 verified.

Agfa Agfapan APX 400 120: authentic silver-gray fine rules, black AGFAPAN band, red line, grayscale dot field and cream outlined APX 400 preserved. Coherent with other approved APX editions. 120 / ISO 400 / BW checked.

Agfa Agfacolor Optima 200: correct silver-gray striping, red rules, warm pixel mosaic and yellow 200 from this earlier edition retained. No II designation added. Compact AGFA header and 120 / ISO 200 / C-41 footer checked.
Ilford Ilfochrome: real white ground, bold black ILFOCHROME, small Color Reversal Film subtitle and magenta-yellow-cyan bands retained. Compact ILFORD header. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 100 / E-6 verified.
Ilford FP4 Plus 24exp: exact white, blue FP4, black PLUS band and 125 stock speed retained with compact ILFORD header. No technical format enlarged. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 125 / BW verified.

Ilford Delta 400 Professional: authentic green striped DELTA/triangle, black 400 and green PROFESSIONAL retained on clean white. Compact ILFORD brand and tiny 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / BW footer match the exact box.

Harman RED: authentic pure red, compact white HARMAN and cream outlined RED lettering faithfully retained. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 125 / C-41 checked. This updates only the existing Library archive cover; no removed capture LUT is restored.

Ilford Delta 400 Professional 24exp: original green striped DELTA triangle, black 400 and white field match this older edition. Family hierarchy consistent with the 36exp box. Correct 35mm / 24exp / ISO 400 / BW footer verified.

Ilford Delta 100 Professional 120: authentic older 100-over-DELTA lockup, blue striped triangle, black striped numerals and white cream paper retained. Compact ILFORD and correct 120 / ISO 100 / BW footer. Era-specific layout preserved.

Alien Film Aeronega: real blue, cream and mint sweeping stripe design, angular AERONEGA and compact italic Alien Film retained. No invented alien mascot added. 120 / ISO 100 / C-41 checked against exact pack.

Lomography Color Negative Film 800 120: authentic lime diagonal stripes, travel-photo collage, multicolor COLOR blocks and dark green NEGATIVE FILM 800 label retained. Compact red brand; 120 / ISO 800 / C-41 checked against the exact box.

Lomography LomoChrome Color 92 120: exact edition uses dark red and black portrait imagery with cream and red condensed type. This sample theme and compact red brand retained, distinct from the 35mm seaside version. 120 / ISO 400 / C-41 checked.
Svema Foto 200: authentic yellow, blue-silver printed band, red outlined 200 and distinctive Svema wordmark retained. Subtle real diagonal blocks preserved. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / BW checked.

Foma Fomapan Classic 100 35mm: exact red-yellow-cream packaging edition, script fomapan, italic CLASSIC band and large stock 100 retained. Small foma brand remains separate from the product wordmark. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 100 / BW checked.

Mr. Negative 250D: exact orange, black band and red 250D retained with the genuine cartoon camera mascot. Brand compact in the top-left. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 250 / ECN-2 footer checked against catalog and original stock.

Mr. Negative Eterna 250D refinement: correct green and red packaging, uniform cream 250D, Eterna title and genuine camera mascot retained. Brand now compact and stacked as on the box. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 250 / ECN-2 checked. Library archive entry only.

Mr. Negative Silver Screen Negative refinement: compact stacked sans-serif brand now matches the family. Genuine monster, red sun, mountain silhouette, teal ground and red-pink title retained from exact package. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / ECN-2 checked.

SupaSnaps Snappit Film: exact lime green, magenta camera panel, cream-on-black stock lettering and real camera illustration retained. Compact SupaSnaps header; incidental logo on printed camera belongs to original illustration. 126 / 24exp / ISO 100 / C-41 verified.

Polaroid High Definition: original blue, yellow waveform, cream italic High Definition and genuine multicolor diamond Polaroid mark retained. No invented rainbow band. 110 / 24exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Agfa Agfacolor HDC Plus 110: authentic red box, compact white AGFA plaque, yellow Agfacolor and gradient HDC plus lettering retained. Genuine multicolor stock typography preserved. 110 / 24exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Agfa Agfacolor Vista 110: original red, compact AGFA plaque, cream italic Vista and genuine green-yellow upper arc / cyan-purple lower arc retained. 110 / 24exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked. Distinct from HDC Plus and Vista Plus editions.

CineStill 400Dynamic 35mm: exact purple, black circular identity and cream thin italic 400Dynamic retained in square layout. Small CineStill FILM header matches the family. Correct 35mm / 36exp / ISO 400 / C-41 footer.
Jessops CS100: exact blue header, gray body, cream Jessops with genuine short multicolor underline and blue/cream CS100 retained. Calm shared spacing. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 100 / E-6 verified.

Jessops Diamond Everyday: original deep blue, yellow diamond EVERYDAY and genuine flowing rainbow wave retained. Compact Jessops brand with real color underline; price flash and clutter omitted. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / C-41 checked.

Lomography LomoChrome Color 92 alternate 120 package: authentic red portrait, cream/red title and three small package sample themes retained as a controlled collage. Compact red brand and correct 120 / ISO 400 / C-41 footer. No unrelated imagery added.

Konica Sepia Professional: original dark sepia-brown, cream high-contrast serif SEPIA, gold professional panel and genuine small ornamental flourish retained. Compact Konica brand. 120 / ISO 400 / C-41 checked against actual package.

Ificolor SHR 100: exact gray, magenta stock title, distinctive black ificolor wordmark and genuine angular magenta-orange-yellow-green stripes retained. 126 / 24exp / ISO 100 / C-41 verified; clean print without real-box damage.

Polaroid Polavision Phototape Land Cassette Type 608: authentic cream, black perforated strip and stacked magenta-to-blue rainbow bands match original. Compact Polaroid and clear full stock title. Polavision / 38.5ft / ISO 40 / Instant footer checked.

Film Corporation of America TriFCA 120: exact orange, cream and olive-gray band, thin geometric TriFCA 120 product lettering and small company header retained. Here 120 is part of the real product name. Footer 120 / ISO 80 checked; no process invented.

Film Corporation of America TriFCA 120 alternate package: real orange upper panel, cream divider, olive-gray lower field and thin geometric TriFCA 120 lettering retained. Compact long company header. Footer 120 / ISO 80 verified; no unsupported process text.

Polaroid 990: exact cobalt blue, white grid-diamond brand, framed blue checker field and tall outlined 990 retained. Integral Film / 10exp per pack / ISO 640 / Instant checked; original box contains two 10-photo packs.

Klick Max Extra Definition Multi Purpose Film: exact yellow-to-red field, compact red Klick plaque, white MAX and genuine purple accent retained. Supporting description remains smaller. 35mm / 36exp / ISO 200 / C-41 verified.

Polaroid Spectra Film: exact blue, cyan italic title, angled instant-photo frame, printed flash and multicolor waveform retained. Genuine diamond brand compact. Footer Integral Film / 10exp / ISO 600 / Instant follows catalog; package identity visually verified.

Impossible Project PX 600 Silver Shade UV+: authentic white, thin PX lettering, grayscale swatches and gray UV+ seal retained. Compact original-style brand. Integral Film / 8exp / ISO 600 / Instant matches catalog; full stock name clear.
JCH Streetpan 400 120: authentic red/black, white STREETPAN, red outlined 400 and genuine diamond JCH mark retained. Clear stock identity in balanced square composition. 120 / ISO 400 / BW checked.

Club Color Natural Color System: authentic blue with colorful wave/dot field, black-and-yellow label frames, small CMY rule and original secondary 800/24 tag preserved. Product title remains primary. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 800 / C-41 footer verified.

IsopanISS matched to the orange Agfa carton with blue diamond wordmark and rounded blue stock panel edged in cream. Cream serif Isopan/ISS, compact maker and small 127 ISO100 BW footer retain the edition's original palette and label proportions.

Herzog Duxopan: authentic red, black stock plaque, condensed cream DUXOPAN and real crowned-heart Herzog symbol retained. Compact brand and 35mm / 12exp / ISO 100 / BW footer checked; technical 135 omitted from hero.

ORWO Chrom UT21: exact magenta/cyan split, stacked ORWO mark, tall condensed CHROM and UT21 lettering retained. UT21 is the real stock designation, not a format numeral. 35mm / 24exp / ISO 100 checked; no process invented.
